Anika Patel: Quick update — Polestar EAP NDA is signed and infra delivery ETA is Tue 03/08. We need to lock bench config + telemetry hooks by EOD Fri. Link to NDA: https://redwood-internal/nda/polestar_eap_v1 :lock:

Marco Li: Awesome. Who's owning the bench config? I can take the perf side (batching/seq).

Sylvia Chen: I'll own telemetry + tagging. Need exact sysmetrics and kv-cache probes from Polestar. @Polestar CI can you paste the NIC/setup details?

Polestar CI: Hi all — network is 25GbE with SR-IOV, Mellanox A40. Firmware v5.2. We will expose SSH jump + a small read-only NFS for traces. Also attaching rack power profile.

Sam (Solutions): For benchmarks, suggest baseline: seq_len=1024, batch=4 then stress at seq=2048,batch=8. We should also capture tail-latency (p95/p99) across 1hr runs.

Marco Li: Agreed. Minimal repro command i'll run on arrival:
```
# litmus run example
./bench --model rwl-v2 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --duration 3600 --out /tmp/polestar_baseline.json
```

Marco Li: I'll add quantization variants after baseline. Expect ~6 hours of runs total.

Sylvia Chen: Telemetry checklist (cc @deploy-bot):
- export /metrics/kv_cache_hits
- sample gpu_temp every 10s
- attach local trace file to s3://redwood-eap/polestar/{run_ts}.json

deploy-bot: Reminder: set retention=90d for s3 prefix s3://redwood-eap/polestar/ (requested by Sylvia Chen) :robot_face:

Anika Patel: Two process asks: 1) legal wants a redacted summary for public joint announcement template (no perf numbers). 2) marketing wants an early go/no-go by the end of the pilot (3 weeks).

Polestar CI: Noted. We'll send rack photos + telemetry access once bench passes smoke. Expected onsite tech window Wed-Thu next week.

Sam (Solutions): Small ask — can we get an SLA on node preemption? We need guarantee for 4 hours/day exclusive during runs.

Polestar CI: We can schedule maintenance windows. I'll confirm exclusive window and add to the runbook.

Marco Li: Action items: Marco -> run baseline & quant variants. Sylvia -> telemetry + retention. Polestar CI -> confirm exclusive window + upload firmware matrix. Anika -> coordinate legal/marketing outputs. Will post an initial run report in channel after first baseline (ETA Wed night).

Anika Patel: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
